steps: The registered composition previews four actors and four groups. Materialization reviews a separate schema-3 Scene2D with identical instance/group IDs. Chinese, English and Japanese at 390px retain fields and review with visible actions. Cancel writes no author files and starts no build.

Save creates only the independent scene source and registration, retaining recipe, recipe metadata and all dependencies byte-for-byte. A GUI-created TXT GDScript is ordinarily saved and attached through first-behavior creation; parameter and signal mapping are reviewed and ordinarily saved without editing recipe or scene bytes.

Real Godot plan/build/headless execution runs the newly materialized scene: preserved instance IDs, leader moves 40px, other actors remain still, and the authored behavior emits materialized_checkpoint(materialized_scene, 73). No author files change during execution.

The actual browser downloads the inspected generated project ZIP. Independent verification, new-directory extraction, exact script-copy comparison and actual Godot import pass with image resources included. Author files remain unchanged.

en.title: Create a 2D scene from a recipe

ja.title: レシピから 2D シーンを作成

limitations: Actual Chrome, local HTTP editor and trusted Godot; installed Tauri, native picker, Android and other operating systems are not exercised.

Fixture preparation registers a generic OC, imports a repository image and registers the example composition in a temporary blank project through production services. Upstream OC/projection/recipe authoring is not claimed.

The GUI creates the independent scene, TXT GDScript, behavior and delivery in one project. Godot headless logic and relocated project import are verified; rendered gameplay and standalone game executables are not claimed.
